# DABAR

> AI-powered spiritual discernment grounded in KJV scripture. Bring the questions faith rarely answers cleanly — anxiety, grief, doubt, purpose — and receive a scripture-based reflection in seconds.

DABAR is a personal reflection tool, not pastoral counsel. Responses are generated with a unified wisdom voice and always cite scripture from the King James Version.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Ask a question and receive a scripture-grounded reflection.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free trial, Personal, Family, and Community plans.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on anxiety, grief, purpose, forgiveness, fear, loneliness, and how to hear from God.
- [Our Beliefs](/doctrine): Doctrinal statement and AI disclosure.
- [Support](/support): Contact, FAQs, and a request form.
- [Privacy](/privacy): How DABAR handles your reflections.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
